subject: ResellCo EU marketplace — vendor onboarding details & PO routing
messages:
From: Elaine Morris <elaine.morris@resellco.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@resellco.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 08:17:00 +0100
Subject: Redwood listing — onboarding & PO process for EU reseller lane

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement here at ResellCo is asking for the paperwork and a quick checklist so we can get you into our EU marketplace catalog. Two items they highlighted: (1) our preferred PO flow (we route POs to a centralized mailbox and require a PO number pre-activation), and (2) tax/evidence for non-EU vendors — specifically whether you can accept gross invoicing with an EU VAT registration or if you require a local fiscal representative.

Can you share the onboarding forms and the PO instructions so we can start the vendor intake? Also attaching our internal vendor intake matrix might help coordinate.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — they want to slot new vendors into next week's activation batch.

Best,
Elaine Morris\Head of Partnerships, ResellCo

Attachment: ResellCo_Vendor_Intake_Matrix.xlsx (referenced)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Morris <elaine.morris@resellco.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Redwood listing — onboarding & PO process for EU reseller lane

Hi Elaine,

Thanks — great meeting yesterday. Quick answers up front and then the attachments:

- PO flow: we can accept standard POs routed to procurements@redwood.ai. For marketplace activations we typically need the PO number and the expected billing start date before the listing goes live.
- Invoicing / VAT: Redwood currently invoices from our EU subsidiary (Redwood Inference EU SARL) and can provide VAT registration info. If ResellCo needs gross invoice with EU VAT applied, we can do that; for some large resellers we also accept net invoices if they provide their VAT reverse-charge confirmation.

I've attached two items for your team: (1) "ResellCo_PO_Instructions.pdf" — short guide we put together for marketplace partners showing PO routing, required invoicing fields, and sample line items; (2) "Redwood_Vendor_W8-W9-vs-EU-VAT-Guide.docx" — explains which tax docs we provide for different regions.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm which PO template ResellCo will use (if different from the attached sample).
2) Procurement sends one test PO (can be $1 or the nominal placeholder) to procurements@redwood.ai with PO number and target go-live date.
3) We return an acknowledgement and a draft invoice; once validated we schedule activation in the marketplace.

Looping in Vanessa and Ben to help with EU billing and the activation schedule.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber\Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Phone: +44 20 7000 1234

Attachments: ResellCo_PO_Instructions.pdf; Redwood_Vendor_W8-W9-vs-EU-VAT-Guide.docx

From: procurement@resellco.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: elaine.morris@resellco.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:05:00 +0100
Subject: RE: Redwood listing — onboarding & PO process for EU reseller lane

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick reply and the materials — much clearer. A few clarifying notes from procurement:

- We will use our standard PO template (attached as "ResellCo_PO_template.xlsx"). Please confirm the mandatory fields we must populate (we see PO number, buyer org unit, billing address, tax ID, and itemized SKU/price).
- For activation scheduling: how many business days do you need after receiving the validated PO to complete marketplace listing? We will be batching vendors on Friday activations.
- VAT: we can accept an invoice with EU VAT if you supply your VAT registration number. Please confirm which VAT number will appear on the invoice (legal entity).

We can send a $1 test PO by EOD today if that helps.

Regards,
Procurement Team
ResellCo

Attachment: ResellCo_PO_template.xlsx

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@resellco.com, elaine.morris@resellco.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:42:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Redwood listing — onboarding & PO process for EU reseller lane

Thanks for the thread — jumping in for billing and ops notes.

Ben — can you confirm the exact billing entity and VAT registration we will use for this listing? I believe EU SARL (Redwood Inference EU SARL) with VAT GB999999999 is correct for now, but want to verify the number and whether we should issue a gross invoice or use reverse-charge wording for ResellCo.

Operationally, once we have the validated PO and the purchase order number, we can complete the marketplace activation within 3 business days if there are no legal exceptions. If procurement sends a $1 test PO today and the fields match our required template, we should be able to get them into the Friday activation batch.

Jonas — I'll take point on the activation calendar and confirm the Friday slot once Ben confirms VAT.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz\Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
